entry.title: New: dsh-quota
entry.summary: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet, TokenRouter, SupaWriter), auto-syncing API keys from the DSH credentials domain with colored usage bars. Exact install spec: github:minokun/dsh-quota. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
